title: Postdoctoral Research Associate, Department of Surgery

cond_0001.intro: The Department of Surgery in the School of Medicine at [Company name masked] seeks a Postdoctoral Research Associate to work in the lab of Dr. Kenneth Brayman.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Participate in planning, design, execution, and management of research projects in a foundational (basic) biological/health science research laboratory in the Department of Surgery
Participate in developing and implementing goals and objectives of studies
Design and execute complex laboratory experiments
Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques
Collect, analyze, and interpret research data
Assist with development and implementation of new and/or revised research methodologies and techniques
Test experimental designs, sampling techniques, and analytical methods and make recommendations for utilization
Assist in establishment of controls, criteria, and research standards
Perform critical analysis of literature relevant to research being undertaken
Assist in the preparation of research papers and manuscripts for publication and presentation at national conferences and workshops, and in the writing of project reports, articles, and other documents
Assist principal investigator in the preparation of proposals to obtain new or renewal of extramural funding in support of research
Coordinate laboratory activities and work assignments of research scientists, graduate and undergraduate students, and laboratory research staff
Oversee and coordinate periodic maintenance and testing of laboratory equipment
Perform additional duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A PhD or MD in an appropriate biological/health science by the appointment start date.
Experience in a biological/health science research capacity.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to translate, adapt and apply academic and/or practical knowledge in the conduct of biological/health science research.
Postdoctoral employment is temporary and is normally limited to an individual who has been awarded a Ph.D. Or equivalent doctorate within the previous five years and who will be involved in full-time research or scholarship at [Company name masked]. Employment as a Postdoctoral Research Associate is viewed as training and is preparatory for a full-time academic or research career, is supervised by a senior scholar, and allows the appointee to publish the results of his/her research or scholarship during the training period.
The University will perform background checks and health screenings on all new hires prior to employment.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

Participate in planning, design, execution, and management of research projects in a foundational (basic) biological/health science research laboratory in the Department of Surgery
Participate in developing and implementing goals and objectives of studies
Design and execute complex laboratory experiments
Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques
Collect, analyze, and interpret research data
Assist with development and implementation of new and/or revised research methodologies and techniques
Test experimental designs, sampling techniques, and analytical methods and make recommendations for utilization
Assist in establishment of controls, criteria, and research standards
Perform critical analysis of literature relevant to research being undertaken
Assist in the preparation of research papers and manuscripts for publication and presentation at national conferences and workshops, and in the writing of project reports, articles, and other documents
Assist principal investigator in the preparation of proposals to obtain new or renewal of extramural funding in support of research
Coordinate laboratory activities and work assignments of research scientists, graduate and undergraduate students, and laboratory research staff
Oversee and coordinate periodic maintenance and testing of laboratory equipment
Perform additional duties as assigned.
cond_0165.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A PhD or MD in an appropriate biological/health science by the appointment start date, or equivalent doctorate.
Some experience in a biological/health science research setting, whether through academic training, lab work, or related practical experience.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to apply and adapt academic or practical knowledge to biological/health science research — this can be developed through coursework, training, or hands-on lab experience.
Postdoctoral employment is temporary and is normally limited to an individual who has been awarded a Ph.D. Or equivalent doctorate within the previous five years and who will be involved in full-time research or scholarship at [Company name masked]. Employment as a Postdoctoral Research Associate is viewed as training and is preparatory for a full-time academic or research career, is supervised by a senior scholar, and allows the appointee to publish the results of his/her research or scholarship during the training period.
[Company name masked] will perform background checks and health screenings on all new hires prior to employment.

Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques

Participate in planning, design, execution, and management of research projects in a foundational (basic) biological/health science research laboratory in the Department of Surgery
Participate in developing and implementing goals and objectives of studies
Design and execute complex laboratory experiments
Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques
Collect, analyze, and interpret research data
Assist with development and implementation of new and/or revised research methodologies and techniques
Test experimental designs, sampling techniques, and analytical methods and make recommendations for utilization
Assist in establishment of controls, criteria, and research standards

cond_0257.intro: The Department of Surgery in the School of Medicine at [Company name masked] seeks a Postdoctoral Research Associate to work in the lab of Dr. Kenneth Brayman. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with biological and health science research.
cond_0257.responsibilities:
Participate in planning, design, execution, and management of research projects in a foundational (basic) biological/health science research laboratory in the Department of Surgery
Participate in developing and implementing goals and objectives of studies
Design and execute complex laboratory experiments
Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques
Collect, analyze, and interpret research data
Assist with development and implementation of new and/or revised research methodologies and techniques
Test experimental designs, sampling techniques, and analytical methods and make recommendations for utilization
Assist in establishment of controls, criteria, and research standards
Perform critical analysis of literature relevant to research being undertaken
Assist in the preparation of research papers and manuscripts for publication and presentation at national conferences and workshops, and in the writing of project reports, articles, and other documents
Assist principal investigator in the preparation of proposals to obtain new or renewal of extramural funding in support of research
Coordinate laboratory activities and work assignments of research scientists, graduate and undergraduate students, and laboratory research staff
Oversee and coordinate periodic maintenance and testing of laboratory equipment
Perform additional duties as assigned.
cond_0257.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A PhD or MD in an appropriate biological/health science by the appointment start date.
Experience in a biological/health science research capacity.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to translate, adapt and apply academic and/or practical knowledge in the conduct of biological/health science research.
Postdoctoral employment is temporary and is normally limited to an individual who has been awarded a Ph.D. Or equivalent doctorate within the previous five years and who will be involved in full-time research or scholarship at [Company name masked]. Employment as a Postdoctoral Research Associate is viewed as training and is preparatory for a full-time academic or research career, is supervised by a senior scholar, and allows the appointee to publish the results of his/her research or scholarship during the training period.

Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques
Collect, analyze, and interpret research data
Assist with development and implementation of new and/or revised research methodologies and techniques

Collaborate in the planning, design, execution, and management of research projects in a foundational (basic) biological/health science research laboratory in the Department of Surgery
Participate in developing and implementing goals and objectives of studies
Design and execute complex laboratory experiments together with the research team
Perform advanced molecular and cellular techniques
Collect, analyze, and interpret research data, sharing findings with the team
Support the development and implementation of new and/or revised research methodologies and techniques
Test experimental designs, sampling techniques, and analytical methods and share recommendations for utilization
Assist in establishment of controls, criteria, and research standards
Perform critical analysis of literature relevant to research being undertaken
Assist in the preparation of research papers and manuscripts for publication and presentation at national conferences and workshops, and in the writing of project reports, articles, and other documents
Support the principal investigator in the preparation of proposals to obtain new or renewal of extramural funding in support of research
Coordinate laboratory activities and work assignments of research scientists, graduate and undergraduate students, and laboratory research staff
Coordinate periodic maintenance and testing of laboratory equipment
Perform additional duties as assigned.
cond_0495.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
A PhD or MD in an appropriate biological/health science by the appointment start date
Experience in a biological/health science research capacity
Preferred Requirements
Ability to translate, adapt, and apply academic and/or practical knowledge in the conduct of biological/health science research
Postdoctoral employment is temporary and is normally limited to an individual who has been awarded a Ph.D. Or equivalent doctorate within the previous five years and who will be involved in full-time research or scholarship at [Company name masked]. Employment as a Postdoctoral Research Associate is viewed as training and is preparatory for a full-time academic or research career, is supervised by a senior scholar, and allows the appointee to publish the results of his/her research or scholarship during the training period.
The University will perform background checks and health screenings on all new hires prior to employment.
To Apply
Please apply through the [Company name masked] job board, and search for R0059729. Internal applicants must apply through their [Company name masked] Workday profile by searching 'Find Jobs'. Complete an application online with the following documents:
CV/Resume
Cover letter
Contact information for 3 references
Upload all materials into the resume submission field, multiple documents can be submitted into this one field. Alternatively, merge all documents into one PDF for submission. Applications that do not contain all required documents will not receive full consideration.
For questions about the application process, please contact Jessica Russo, Recruiter, at sxv9zv@virginia.edu.
